title: Shipping Basis When Only Part of an Order Comes Back
content:
Where a Returns & Exchanges return takes back only part of an Online Orders order, any original shipping refunded with it is scaled by the shipping basis — the part of the order the return takes back.

## Shipping basis

| Order and return | Shipping basis |
|---|---|
| The order was charged no shipping fee | Nothing to refund |
| The merchandise credited on the return is less than the order's net merchandise at placement | The merchandise credited on the return divided by the order's net merchandise at placement |
| Any other return | The whole fee |

- **Merchandise credited on the return:** the merchandise parts of the return's credit entries, added together (their tax parts are not counted).
- **Net merchandise at placement:** the order's merchandise subtotal less its discount total.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Shipping fee charged | Merchandise credited on the return | Net merchandise at placement | Shipping basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | 80.00 | 200.00 | Nothing to refund |
| 9.95 | 80.00 | 200.00 | 80.00 divided by 200.00, that is 0.4 |
| 9.95 | 200.00 | 200.00 | The whole fee |
